name: Voronoy
summary:
Voronoy.io is a real-time multiplayer macro-strategy game. Players compete to control a map structured on Voronoi diagram mathematics. The objective is to capture adjacent cells, manage energy distribution networks, and eliminate opposing players by breaching their border defenses. The application runs directly in HTML5-compatible web browsers without client downloads.
Players deploy with a reserve of 8,000 energy points. Selecting a starting cell consumes a portion of this reserve directly proportional to the cell's geographic size.Players capture neutral and enemy cells by directing energy into them. Attacking a target cell simultaneously from multiple controlled adjacent cells mathematically reduces the required capture time.
